# Pulling a good espresso shot

Espresso is a small, strong coffee brewed by forcing hot water through finely ground beans.

## How long should an espresso shot take?

An espresso shot should take 25 to 30 seconds from the first drip.

Start the timer when the pump starts, not when the first drops appear. A shot that runs much faster usually tastes sour and thin.

## Grind size

Grind the beans just before you brew, and adjust the grinder one small step at a time.
